news.title: NASA Highlights Lessons Learned From Swift Boost Mission
news.summary: A commercial mission to boost NASA’s Swift observatory concluded without raising the spacecraft’s orbit, but the agency and industry vendor gained valuable experience that will benefit future in-space servicing programs.
